subject: Planning: NovusHealth Executive Workshop — onsite + hybrid options
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FW: NovusHealth exec workshop windows + travel constraints

Team —

Novus (Ava) asked for a focused 1.5 day executive workshop to cover deployment options, SLA metrics, and a short ops runbook. She mentioned week of Jul 20 as the preferred period. Before I loop them in, can we: 

- Propose 2 date options (one onsite, one hybrid) that work for our execs (Dylan + Marissa + Solutions lead).
- Flag any travel constraints: Marissa has a board review Jul 22 morning; Karthik is OOO Jul 19–20.
- Quick AV checklist for hybrid deliverable (room, mics, laptop swap, webcast). Laura, can you draft a short room/AV ask that I can send to their facilities?

I want to keep this lean — agenda draft + logistics + a mutual action plan. Attachments: draft agenda v2 + basic AV checklist (placeholder).

Thanks,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: NovusHealth exec workshop windows + travel constraints

Thanks — quick context: NovusHealth (enterprise, healthcare payer) has three stakeholder groups: CTO/policy, Head of ML Ops, and a procurement participant. They want an onsite to observe latency/cost profiles but are open to hybrid if approvals don't come through.

Attendee sketch (they asked us to propose):
- Novus: Ava Reynolds (Dir, ML), Peter Durant (VP Eng), procurement rep TBD
- Redwood: Dylan (AE), Marissa (CS Lead), Laura (Solutions), maybe one applied-ML for a 30m deep-dive

Constraints: travel approvals at Novus take 10 business days. If they want Jul 21 onsite we need to confirm logistics this week.

I added a couple of notes on agenda in the attached draft_agenda_v2.pdf.

—Karthik

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava.reynolds@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed dates + format for NovusHealth exec workshop (week of Jul 20)

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the chat earlier. Per our conversation, we can support a 1.5 day executive workshop either fully onsite (Redwood team travel) or hybrid with a short in-person presence. Two concrete options for your planning: 

Option A — Onsite (preferred for demos & ops run-through)
- Date: Tue Jul 21 (half-day) + Wed Jul 22 (full) 
- Location: Novus HQ or nearby conference room (we can provide AV checklist)
- Redwood attendees: Dylan, Marissa, Laura, applied-ML engineer (30m deep-dive)

Option B — Hybrid
- Date: Wed Jul 22 (1.5 days condensed into Wed PM + Thu morning)
- Redwood attendees: Marissa + Laura onsite, Dylan remote (PST) — we’ll run a tech check 30m prior

Logistics I need from you to lock:
- Preferred option (A or B)
- Onsite attendee approvals + any travel blackout dates
- Any dietary restrictions / accessibility needs

I attached a draft agenda and a short AV checklist. If you confirm Option A, we’ll send a proposed mutual action plan with travel and calendar holds (I’ll include timezone blocks for your EMEA folks too).

Best,
Dylan

Attachments: novus_draft_agenda_v2.pdf, hybrid_av_checklist.docx
--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198

From: Ava Reynolds <ava.reynolds@novushealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Durant <peter.durant@novushealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 08:50:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Proposed dates + format for NovusHealth exec workshop (week of Jul 20)

Hi Dylan —

Option A sounds better; our execs prefer in-person for the ops run-through. Jul 21–22 works for the group on our side. A few notes: 

- We need a high-level attendee list from Redwood for travel approval (name, title, dob last 4 for badge) — Peter looping in procurement.
- Catering: two light lunches + coffee breaks; one plated dinner on Jul 21 for 6 people (please advise any dietary restrictions).
- AV: we’ll need a webcast link for remote stakeholders in Europe (they're in CET). Can you include suggested start times to accommodate CET overlap?
- Hotel: most execs will use the nearby Marriott; can you share the hotel proposal?

I’ll ask procurement for a travel approval by next Tue (7/7).

Thanks —
Ava

Ava / team —

Great — thanks for confirming Option A (Jul 21–22 onsite). Next steps from Redwood: 

1) I’ll send a concise mutual action plan (MAP) today with travel approvals needed and the attendee roster fields Procurement requested.
2) Marissa / Laura — can you please place calendar holds now for Jul 21 08:30–17:00 PDT and Jul 22 08:30–16:30 PDT, and include an all-day timezone block for CET participants (Jul 22 17:30–21:30 CET) so remote execs have the webcast window. Put "NovusHealth Exec Workshop (tentative)" on the invites.
3) Laura — please send a one-page AV checklist to Novus facilities and confirm room mic + webcast encoder (we may bring a backup eGPU for the demo).
4) Karthik — I’ll need the final attendee names/titles for travel approval (I will collect DOB last 4 at procurement's request).

Attachments: onsite_hotel_proposal.pdf (hotel options near Novus HQ), novus_draft_agenda_v2.pdf, hybrid_av_checklist.docx

I am also adding a shared Google Calendar placeholder (link below) and will follow up with travel booking once procurement clears the attendees.

Shared links: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=novus-workshop-20260721

Best,
Dylan
